hits.snippet:
This acquisition strengthens our service offering and expands our footprint across key regions, enabling us to support even more customers with responsive support, industry-leading technology, and tailored print management strategies. By bringing Fleet’s capabilities, people, and longstanding client relationships into Anglotech, we continue to invest in delivering superior service, long-term value, and scalable print and document solutions for businesses nationally. [...] Anglotech Group is pleased to welcome Fleet Managed Print Services into the business as part of our ongoing buy‑and‑build strategy. Fleet has built a strong reputation for delivering reliable, efficient, and cost‑effective managed print solutions, helping customers streamline their document workflows and improve operational performance. Their customer-first approach and technical expertise align perfectly with our values, making this a natural and exciting fit for the Group. [...] We look forward to combining our expertise and welcoming Fleet Managed Print Services’ customers and team members into the Anglotech family as we continue to grow, innovate, and enhance our position as one of the UK’s leading providers of managed print and document technology.
